fusions.name: Cutting Crescent
fusions.desc: Cuts a target at or below 30% health for 16 damage, consuming every affliction on it for 1.4 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Scything Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 4 tiles long that deals 4 damage to everything in it.

fusions.name: Windfall Mend
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you, with a 10% chance to heal critically. Its healing rises 8% for every tenth of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Harvest Tempo
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
